title: FeedbackEvent
description: Canonical event shape produced by @llm-feedback-middleware/core. Source of truth lives in packages/core/src/event-types.ts (Zod). Regenerate this file via schemas/generate.ts when the Zod schema changes.

event_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this event.

event_version.description: Schema version this event was written against.

timestamp.description: When the underlying user action occurred (ISO 8601).

captured_at.description: When the framework recorded the event (ISO 8601).

partition_key.description: Stream key for ordering. Defaults to artifact_id.

action.description: Registered action name (e.g. approve, edit, reject, regenerate, expired, silent_accept, disuse).

artifact_type.description: Registered artifact type name (e.g. draft, summary, brief).

artifact_id.description: Identifier of the artifact this event is about.

producer.description: Identifier of the producing agent or component.

payload.description: Action-specific payload. Validated against the action's payload schema by the classifier.

correction_of.description: event_id of an earlier event this event corrects.
